decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering, so its in-house R&D and long project experience let it interpret early results and refine the product rather than abandon it.

The energy management system builds on the firm's automation software and fits its strategic direction toward networked, energy-efficient water infrastructure, and its R&D and university cooperation give it the absorptive capacity to develop it further.
The overflow flap gate is a close extension of the established weir and gate business, and its dedicated web page signals commitment, so it is very likely to be kept.
